1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi.

2.text: Nategereje Uwiteka nihanganye,Antegera ugutwi yumva gutaka kwanjye.

3.text: Kandi ankura mu rwobo rwo kurimbura no mu byondo by'isayo,Ashyira ibirenge byanjye ku rutare,Akomeza intambwe zanjye.

4.text: Kandi yashyize indirimbo nshya mu kanwa kanjye,Ni yo shimwe ry'Imana yacu,Benshi bazabireba batinye, biringire Uwiteka.

5.text: Hahirwa uwiringira Uwiteka,Kandi ntahindukirire abibone cyangwa abiyobagiriza gukurikiza ibinyoma.

6.text: Uwiteka Mana yanjye,Imirimo itangaza wakoze ni myinshi,Kandi ibyo utekereza kutugirira na byo ni byinshi,Ntihariho uwagereranywa nawe.Nashaka kubyātura no kubirondora,Byaruta ubwinshi ibyo nshoboye kubara.

7.text: Ibitambo n'amaturo y'ifu ntubyishimira,Amatwi yanjye urayazibuye,Ibitambo byokeje n'ibitambo by'ibyaha ntiwabishatse.

8.text: Mperako ndavuga nti “Dore ndaje,Mu muzingo w'igitabo ni ko byanditswe kuri jye.

9.text: Mana yanjye nishimira gukora ibyo ukunda,Ni koko amategeko yawe ari mu mutima wanjye.”

10.text: Namamaza ubutumwa bwiza bwo gukiranuka mu iteraniro ryinshi,Sinzabumba akanwa kanjye,Uwiteka urabizi.

11.text: Ntabwo mpisha gukiranuka kwawe mu mutima wanjye,Mvuga umurava wawe n'agakiza kawe.Imbabazi zawe n'ukuri kwawe simbihisha iteraniro ryinshi.

12.text: Uwiteka, nawe ntunyime kugira neza kwawe,Imbabazi zawe n'ukuri kwawe bijye bindinda iteka.

13.text: Kuko ibyago bitabarika bingose,Ibyo nakiraniwe bingezeho nkaba ntabasha kureba.Biruta umusatsi wo ku mutwe wanjye ubwinshi,Bituma umutima wanjye umvamo.

15.text: Abashakira ubugingo bwanjye kuburimbura bakorwe n'isoni bamwarane,Abishimira ibyago byanjye basubizwe inyuma bagire igisuzuguriro.

16.text: Abambwira bati “Ahaa, ahaa”,Barekwe ku bw'isoni zabo.

17.text: Abagushaka bose bakwishimire bakunezererwe,Abakunda agakiza kawe bajye bavuga bati“Uwiteka ahimbazwe.”

18.text: Icyakora jyeweho ndi umunyamubabaro n'umukene,Ariko Uwiteka anyitaho.Ni wowe mutabazi wanjye n'umukiza wanjye,Mana yanjye ntutinde.
